FAQ

Features

How can I learn about the features of Age of Berk?
The most important details about the dragons are included in the in-game Book of Dragons.

Extra information about dragons, and information about the rest of the features, can be found here.
Why isn't XYZ Feature not Working Properly?
Make sure the add-on is installed properly (look at the Technical Details section). Also make sure you have turned on the necessary experiments (You can see which ones are currently needed on the download page).

Check that what is happening isn't a known bug. If it isn't there, and you are certain the problem isn't on your end, make a detailed bug report. The more details, the more likely we will be able to fix it. If you don't give us all the details listed, we may not be able to figure out what is wrong.
How can I request a feature?
Join Our Discord! We have a special area for ideas, and also have frequent polls and questions that allow you to shape the future of Age of Berk!

Technical Details

What Minecraft version is the add-on for?
The add-on will almost always work exclusively in the most recent version of Minecraft. If the add-on isn't even installing, make sure you are updated to the latest version of Minecraft. You can find that here. (look for the first version that says Bedrock)
Why is the add-on not importing on Android?
This is an issue with the platform, not our add-on. See this official Mojang bug report for more information.
How do I install Age of Berk?
We have a handy guide at the bottom of the download page.
How do I update Age of Berk?
Updating an add-on can cause some problems when done incorrectly, so please follow these steps:

Make a Backup of Your World
- This can prevent loss of progress if you do something wrong.
- There is an easy way to make a backup within Minecraft. Simply scroll to the bottom of that world's settings and click the "Copy World" button.

Remove the Old Version
- Remove both the behavior pack and resource pack from the world. Do not open the world until you re-add the add-on

Add the New Version
- Add the behavior pack and resource pack with the latest version of Age of Berk to the world.

Open the World and Test
- Re-open the world
- Check that new features are available and that you haven't lost any progress before calling the updating process a success.
What does the versioning system mean?
Age of Berk uses a modified form of semantic versioning, and is approaching v2.0.

Unlike normal semantic versioning, we are using versions starting at 1.5 and until 2.0 as development versions of v2.0. This means that those versions could potentially present more bugs than other versions, though we are working to avoid that.

Worlds that have previously used one version can not use a lower version without possible danger to your world. Downgrading this add-on is not supported.

Bug reports are only accepted for the latest version. Please double check that the bug occurs in the latest version before submitting a bug report.
